objectiveText: * Objective: Go to College
description: Attend your very first financial literacy lecture at City College. Simply visit College to complete today's task!
hintText: Walk to City College in the north-west. Visiting completes today's task!

objectiveText: * Objective: Compare Prices at Shop
description: Visit the corner supermarket and practice comparing unit prices. Visiting completes today's task!
hintText: Head south-west to the Shop. Visiting completes today's task!

objectiveText: * Objective: Play Maths Speed Challenge
description: Test your mental math! Beat the countdown timer and solve rapid arithmetic problems at Maths Speed House.
hintText: Visit the Maths Speed House south of the highway to play and complete today's task.

objectiveText: ◆ Special Event: Freelance Poster Design Gig!
description: A local cafe owner hired you to design promotional flyers and festival social media banners over the weekend!
hintText: Claim your freelance windfall in the event dialog!

objectiveText: ◆ Special Event: Cracked Phone Screen!
description: Your phone slipped from your study desk and shattered the display glass. Immediate repair is required.
hintText: Settle your phone repair in the event dialog!

objectiveText: * Objective: Play Memory Match at Game Arcade
description: Visit the Neon Game Arcade in the south-west and flip cards to match financial wisdom pairs!
hintText: Head to the Game Arcade in the south-west to play Memory Match.

objectiveText: * Objective: Hang Out at Friend's House
description: Hang out with friends on West Street and practice resisting peer pressure spending. Visiting completes today's task!
hintText: Walk to Friend's House on West Street to complete today's task.

objectiveText: * Objective: Answer Financial Quiz at Library
description: Visit City Central Library and answer quiz questions on savings, needs vs wants, and interest.
hintText: Head north-east to the Library to take the Financial Literacy Quiz!

objectiveText: ◆ Special Event: Bicycle Flat Tire!
description: Oh no! Your bicycle tire has a puncture on your way back from school. Choose how to handle this unexpected cost.
hintText: Choose how to solve your bicycle flat tire to continue.

objectiveText: * Objective: Open Savings Account at Bank
description: Visit the National Bank in the north-east to manage deposits and understand interest growth.
hintText: Head to the Bank in the north-east. Visiting completes today's task!

objectiveText: * Objective: Word Finder Vocabulary Quest
description: Discover all vocabulary words from the letter wheel to earn savings bonuses and boost score!
hintText: Head south-west to Word Finder House to play today's word puzzle challenge.

objectiveText: ◆ Special Event: Viral Fever & Clinic Visit
description: A sudden viral fever hit you before mid-terms. Doctor consultation and prescriptions cost you money.
hintText: Pay clinic consultation and medication in the event dialog.

objectiveText: * Objective: Memory Match Arcade Challenge
description: Match financial cards to unlock savings wisdom at the Neon Game Arcade.
hintText: Visit the Game Arcade in the south-west to play Memory Match.

objectiveText: ◆ Special Event: Energy Saver Superhero!
description: You remembered to turn off bedroom lights, fans, and TV whenever leaving the room all week! Decide what to do with your bonus.
hintText: Make your choice in the Energy Saver Event to advance.

objectiveText: * Objective: Library Financial IQ Quiz
description: Test your knowledge on avoiding credit card traps and high-interest debt at City Library.
hintText: Head north-east to the Library to play Quiz Master!

objectiveText: ◆ Special Event: Mandatory Lab Manual & Kit Fee
description: Department lab practicals require purchasing the official experiment manual and safety component kit.
hintText: Settle required academic lab fee in the event dialog.

objectiveText: * Objective: Play Word Finder Challenge
description: Connect letters on the wheel at Word Finder House to discover vocabulary words and complete today's task.
hintText: Head to Word Finder House in the south-west to play and complete today's task.

objectiveText: ◆ Special Event: Lost Purse at Central Park!
description: You spotted a brown coin purse with keys on a park bench. Someone might be searching for it! What will you do?
hintText: Make your choice with the lost purse to continue.

objectiveText: ◆ Special Event: Buy Expensive Gift & Attend Party
description: A close batchmate is throwing a major birthday and cultural fest celebration at the city plaza.
hintText: Choose your celebration contribution in the event dialog.

objectiveText: * Objective: Mindful Snacks at Bakery & Cafe
description: Visit Sweet Crumbs Bakery & Cafe and learn to enjoy budget-friendly treats without overspending!
hintText: Head east to Sweet Crumbs Bakery & Cafe on East Street.

objectiveText: ◆ Special Event: Extra Tutoring Session Bonus!
description: You provided math coaching to junior school students, and grateful parents handed you a performance bonus!
hintText: Claim your tutoring bonus in the event dialog!

objectiveText: ◆ Special Event: Hostel TV Short-Circuit Repair
description: A sudden electrical short-circuit in the student residence common room requires shared contribution.
hintText: Pay your maintenance share in the event dialog.

objectiveText: ◆ Special Event: Sudden Monsoon Shower!
description: Dark rain clouds burst and heavy monsoon rain pours down outside the Town Bakery! Choose how to handle it.
hintText: Make your choice in the Monsoon Rain Event to continue.

objectiveText: * Objective: Investing Master Quiz at Library
description: Demonstrate your knowledge of compound interest, stocks, and inflation at City Library!
hintText: Head north-east to the Library to play Quiz Master!

objectiveText: * Objective: Word Search Wealth Vocabulary
description: Search and circle advanced wealth and economy terms in the letter grid at Word Search House.
hintText: Visit the Word Search House in the north-west to play.

objectiveText: ◆ Special Event: Department Lab Manual & Kit Fee
description: Semester final experiment manuals and component supplies fee is due today.
hintText: Settle department lab fee in the event dialog.

objectiveText: ◆ Special Event: Scrap Recycling Drive!
description: You gathered old newspapers and cardboard cartons around the house. Decide what to do with the recyclables.
hintText: Make your choice in the Recycling Event to finish today's objective.

objectiveText: * Objective: Memory Match Arcade Champion
description: Set a new high score in Memory Match at the Neon Game Arcade before the month closes!
hintText: Head to the Game Arcade in the south-west to play.

objectiveText: * Objective: Eco Savings Walk at City Park
description: Reflect on how sustainable living and green choices cut energy bills and grow personal wealth!
hintText: Walk to City Park in the north-west to complete today's task.

objectiveText: * Objective: Final Month-End Financial Audit
description: Review your 30-day savings records, debt status, and investment growth to finalize your score!
hintText: Return home to your Student Residence to finish the 30-day challenge!
